name: @harness/sandbox-docker
description: The run sandbox: one Docker container per run for agent-written code, the headless browser, ffmpeg and renders. Holds the image and the driver that starts, uses and removes it.

scripts.image:lock: docker run --rm -i python:3.12-slim sh -c "pip install -q --root-user-action=ignore --disable-pip-version-check uv==0.13.0 && uv pip compile - --python-version 3.12 --no-header --no-annotate" < image/requirements.in > image/requirements.txt
scripts.image:lock:voice: docker run --rm -v ./image:/src:ro python:3.12-slim sh -c "pip install -q --root-user-action=ignore --disable-pip-version-check uv==0.13.0 && uv pip compile /src/requirements-voice.in -c /src/requirements.txt --python-version 3.12 --no-header --no-annotate" > image/requirements-voice.txt
